subject: Archelon, Mosasaurus, and Plesiosaurus Group Shot
prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated style. **Ultra-bright, high-noon sunny lighting** in a vibrant prehistoric shallow lagoon beach setting. A friendly, massive prehistoric sea turtle Archelon is smiling and playfully arranging four perfectly spherical, matte-white rubbery eggs in a clean golden sand pit nest, while a gigantic Mosasaurus and a long-necked Plesiosaurus look on from the shallow turquoise water with admiration. **Saturation is high with vivid coral-reef blues, shimmering green sea lettuce, and warm golden beach light.** Caption in the upper third: 'Marine Eggs!' in bright coral-pink, thick 3D mixed-case block letters with a glossy finish. Intricate, organic leathery skin textures on the turtle and sleek reptilian scales on the marine predators. No shadows on faces; extremely well-lit, crisp water surface refractions, and cheerful.
visual_logic: Matches the exact brightness, saturation, and joyful celebratory energy of the Dino Eggs and Ptero Eggs game cards to maintain a cohesive brand ecosystem. It highlights the unique spherical, leathery beach-nesting behavior of sea turtles alongside the ocean-dwelling clades that kids will discover in the game.
